panels.title: Needs attention
panels.description: Lists only what needs you now, in every room, whatever the Room filter. CO₂ at 1000 ppm or more: open a window. Humidity at 70 % or more, now and as the average of the last hour: air the room, damp air feeds mould. PM2.5 at 35 µg/m³ or more, now and as the average of the last 15 minutes: smoke or cooking, open a window. Also a filter to replace, a purifier that stopped, a sensor with no reading, and a hub that stopped answering. The numbers are the room tiles' 5-minute averages.

targets.expr: round(max by (room) (avg_over_time((max by (sensor, room) (ikea_air_co2_ppm{room=~".*"}) > 0)[5m:30s]))) >= 1000 and on() (time() - max(ikea_dirigera_last_success_timestamp_seconds) < 300)

round(max by (room) (avg_over_time((max by (sensor, room) (ikea_air_humidity_percent{room=~".*"}) > 0)[5m:30s]))) >= 70 and on(room) (max by (room) (avg_over_time((max by (sensor, room) (ikea_air_humidity_percent{room=~".*"}) > 0)[1h:1m])) >= 70) and on() (time() - max(ikea_dirigera_last_success_timestamp_seconds) < 300)

round(max by (room) (avg_over_time((max by (sensor, room) (ikea_air_pm25_micrograms_per_cubic_meter{room=~".*"}) and on(sensor, room) (max by (sensor, room) (ikea_air_humidity_percent{room=~".*"}) > 0))[5m:30s]))) >= 35 and on(room) (max by (room) (avg_over_time((max by (sensor, room) (ikea_air_pm25_micrograms_per_cubic_meter{room=~".*"}) and on(sensor, room) (max by (sensor, room) (ikea_air_humidity_percent{room=~".*"}) > 0))[15m:30s])) >= 35) and on() (time() - max(ikea_dirigera_last_success_timestamp_seconds) < 300)
max by (sensor) (ikea_air_purifier_filter_alarm) == 1 and on() (time() - max(ikea_dirigera_last_success_timestamp_seconds) < 300)
max by (sensor) (max_over_time(ikea_air_purifier_running[5m])) == 0 and on() (time() - max(ikea_dirigera_last_success_timestamp_seconds) < 300)

((max by (room) (max_over_time(ikea_air_humidity_percent[1d])) > 0) unless on(room) (max by (room) (max_over_time(ikea_air_humidity_percent[5m])) > 0)) * 0 and on() (time() - max(ikea_dirigera_last_success_timestamp_seconds) < 300)
(time() - max(max_over_time(ikea_dirigera_last_success_timestamp_seconds[1d])) > 300) or on() (absent_over_time(ikea_dirigera_last_success_timestamp_seconds[1d]) * 86400)
targets.legendFormat: ⚠ No update from the hub for

panels.title: Temperature
panels.description: Average of the last 5 minutes in each room. Comfortable: bedroom about 16-19 °C, living room 19-22 °C. The sensors may read about 2 °C high until a correction is set in the exporter.

targets.expr:
(label_replace(round(avg_over_time((max by (sensor, room) (ikea_air_temperature_celsius{room=~"$room"}) and on(sensor, room) (max by (sensor, room) (ikea_air_humidity_percent{room=~"$room"}) > 0))[5m:30s]), 0.1), "name", "$1", "room", "(.*)") and on() (time() - max(ikea_dirigera_last_success_timestamp_seconds) < 300))
or on(sensor, room) label_replace(max by (sensor, room) (max_over_time(ikea_air_temperature_celsius{room=~"$room"}[1d])) * 0 - 1, "name", "$1: no reading", "room", "(.*)")

panels.title: Humidity
panels.description: Average of the last 5 minutes in each room. Good: 40-60 %. Dry below, humid above. Above 70 % for hours, mould can grow.

targets.expr:
((label_replace((round(avg_over_time((max by (sensor, room) (ikea_air_humidity_percent{room=~"$room"}) > 0)[5m:30s]), 1)) < 40, "name", "$1: dry", "room", "(.*)")
 or label_replace((round(avg_over_time((max by (sensor, room) (ikea_air_humidity_percent{room=~"$room"}) > 0)[5m:30s]), 1)) >= 40 <= 60, "name", "$1: good", "room", "(.*)")
 or label_replace((round(avg_over_time((max by (sensor, room) (ikea_air_humidity_percent{room=~"$room"}) > 0)[5m:30s]), 1)) > 60, "name", "$1: humid", "room", "(.*)")) and on() (time() - max(ikea_dirigera_last_success_timestamp_seconds) < 300))
or on(sensor, room) label_replace(max by (sensor, room) (max_over_time(ikea_air_humidity_percent{room=~"$room"}[1d])) * 0 - 1, "name", "$1: no reading", "room", "(.*)")

panels.title: CO₂
panels.description: Average of the last 5 minutes in each room. Fresh below 800 ppm, fair up to 1000 ppm. From 1000 ppm the room is stuffy: open a window.

targets.expr:
((label_replace((round(avg_over_time((max by (sensor, room) (ikea_air_co2_ppm{room=~"$room"}) > 0)[5m:30s]), 1)) < 800, "name", "$1: fresh", "room", "(.*)")
 or label_replace((round(avg_over_time((max by (sensor, room) (ikea_air_co2_ppm{room=~"$room"}) > 0)[5m:30s]), 1)) >= 800 < 1000, "name", "$1: fair", "room", "(.*)")
 or label_replace((round(avg_over_time((max by (sensor, room) (ikea_air_co2_ppm{room=~"$room"}) > 0)[5m:30s]), 1)) >= 1000, "name", "$1: stuffy", "room", "(.*)")) and on() (time() - max(ikea_dirigera_last_success_timestamp_seconds) < 300))
or on(sensor, room) label_replace(max by (sensor, room) (max_over_time(ikea_air_co2_ppm{room=~"$room"}[1d])) * 0 - 1, "name", "$1: no reading", "room", "(.*)")

panels.title: PM2.5
panels.description: Fine dust, average of the last 5 minutes in each room. Clean below 15 µg/m³, the WHO guideline for a 24-hour average. From 35 µg/m³ it is smoky: open a window. Cooking and candles cause short peaks.

targets.expr:
((label_replace((round(avg_over_time((max by (sensor, room) (ikea_air_pm25_micrograms_per_cubic_meter{room=~"$room"}) and on(sensor, room) (max by (sensor, room) (ikea_air_humidity_percent{room=~"$room"}) > 0))[5m:30s]), 1)) < 15, "name", "$1: clean", "room", "(.*)")
 or label_replace((round(avg_over_time((max by (sensor, room) (ikea_air_pm25_micrograms_per_cubic_meter{room=~"$room"}) and on(sensor, room) (max by (sensor, room) (ikea_air_humidity_percent{room=~"$room"}) > 0))[5m:30s]), 1)) >= 15 < 35, "name", "$1: elevated", "room", "(.*)")
 or label_replace((round(avg_over_time((max by (sensor, room) (ikea_air_pm25_micrograms_per_cubic_meter{room=~"$room"}) and on(sensor, room) (max by (sensor, room) (ikea_air_humidity_percent{room=~"$room"}) > 0))[5m:30s]), 1)) >= 35, "name", "$1: smoky", "room", "(.*)")) and on() (time() - max(ikea_dirigera_last_success_timestamp_seconds) < 300))
or on(sensor, room) label_replace(max by (sensor, room) (max_over_time(ikea_air_pm25_micrograms_per_cubic_meter{room=~"$room"}[1d])) * 0 - 1, "name", "$1: no reading", "room", "(.*)")

panels.title: Temperature over time
panels.description: Gray band: comfortable, about 16-19 °C in a bedroom and 19-22 °C in other rooms. Pick 1 room in the Room filter to see its comfortable range. The sensors may read about 2 °C high until a correction is set in the exporter. A gap means no reading from the sensor or the hub.

defaults.noValue: No readings in this time range

targets.expr: (min(max by (room) (ikea_air_temperature_celsius{room=~"$room", room=~"(?i).*bedroom.*"}) * 0 + 16 or max by (room) (ikea_air_temperature_celsius{room=~"$room", room!~"(?i).*bedroom.*"}) * 0 + 19)) and on() (count(count by (room) (ikea_air_temperature_celsius{room=~"$room"})) == 1)

(max(max by (room) (ikea_air_temperature_celsius{room=~"$room", room=~"(?i).*bedroom.*"}) * 0 + 19 or max by (room) (ikea_air_temperature_celsius{room=~"$room", room!~"(?i).*bedroom.*"}) * 0 + 22)) and on() (count(count by (room) (ikea_air_temperature_celsius{room=~"$room"})) == 1)

(max by (sensor, room) (ikea_air_temperature_celsius{room=~"$room"}) and on(sensor, room) (max by (sensor, room) (ikea_air_humidity_percent{room=~"$room"}) > 0)) and on() (time() - max(ikea_dirigera_last_success_timestamp_seconds) < 300)

panels.title: Humidity over time
panels.description: Gray band: 40-60 %, comfortable. A gap means no reading from the sensor or the hub.

defaults.noValue: No readings in this time range

targets.expr: (max by (sensor, room) (ikea_air_humidity_percent{room=~"$room"}) > 0) and on() (time() - max(ikea_dirigera_last_success_timestamp_seconds) < 300)

panels.title: CO₂ over time
panels.description: Highest reading in each time step, so short peaks stay visible. Dashed line: 1000 ppm, time to open a window. A gap means no reading from the sensor or the hub.

defaults.noValue: No readings in this time range

targets.expr: (max by (sensor, room) (max_over_time(ikea_air_co2_ppm{room=~"$room"}[$__interval])) > 0) and on() (time() - max(ikea_dirigera_last_success_timestamp_seconds) < 300)

panels.title: PM2.5 over time
panels.description: Highest reading in each time step. Dashed line: 15 µg/m³, the WHO guideline for a 24-hour average; short cooking peaks above it are normal. The scale is logarithmic above 10 µg/m³, so big peaks do not flatten the everyday level. A gap means no reading from the sensor or the hub.

defaults.noValue: No readings in this time range

targets.expr: (max by (sensor, room) (max_over_time(ikea_air_pm25_micrograms_per_cubic_meter{room=~"$room"}[$__interval])) and on(sensor, room) (max by (sensor, room) (max_over_time(ikea_air_humidity_percent{room=~"$room"}[$__interval])) > 0)) and on() (time() - max(ikea_dirigera_last_success_timestamp_seconds) < 300)

panels.title: Purifier
panels.description: Fan: how hard it runs, as a share of top speed (the hub reports 0-50). In auto mode the purifier speeds up when it senses particles; manual is a fixed speed set in the IKEA Home smart app. Filter: Replace means fit a new particle filter, then reset the filter reminder in the app.

defaults.noValue: No purifier in the selected rooms

targets.expr:
(label_replace(label_replace(max by (sensor, room, mode) (ikea_air_purifier_fan_mode{room=~"$room"}) == 1, "mode", "manual", "mode", "on") * on(sensor, room) group_left() (max by (sensor, room) (ikea_air_purifier_motor_speed{room=~"$room"}) * 2), "name", "Fan in $1 mode", "mode", "(.*)") and on() (time() - max(ikea_dirigera_last_success_timestamp_seconds) < 300))
or on(sensor, room) label_replace(max by (sensor, room) (max_over_time(ikea_air_purifier_motor_speed{room=~"$room"}[1d])) * 0 - 1, "name", "Fan: no reading", "", "")

(label_replace(max by (sensor, room) (ikea_air_purifier_filter_alarm{room=~"$room"}), "name", "Filter", "", "") and on() (time() - max(ikea_dirigera_last_success_timestamp_seconds) < 300))
or on(sensor, room) label_replace(max by (sensor, room) (max_over_time(ikea_air_purifier_filter_alarm{room=~"$room"}[1d])) * 0 - 1, "name", "Filter: no reading", "", "")

panels.title: Fan speed over time
panels.description: How hard the fan ran, as a share of top speed: the highest value in each time step. A peak means the purifier sensed particles and cleaned the air. 0 means it was off. A gap means no reading from the hub.

defaults.noValue: No purifier in the selected rooms

targets.expr: (max by (sensor, room) (max_over_time(ikea_air_purifier_motor_speed{room=~"$room"}[$__interval])) * 2) and on() (time() - max(ikea_dirigera_last_success_timestamp_seconds) < 300)

panels.title: Particles the purifier senses
panels.description: The purifier's own particle reading: the highest value in each time step. Auto mode sets the fan speed from it. It has no unit and does not match the room sensors, so use it to see why the fan sped up, not to judge the air. A gap means no reading from the hub.

defaults.noValue: No purifier in the selected rooms

targets.expr: max by (sensor, room) (max_over_time(ikea_air_purifier_pm25{room=~"$room"}[$__interval])) and on() (time() - max(ikea_dirigera_last_success_timestamp_seconds) < 300)

title: DIRIGERA Air Quality
description: Indoor air at home: what needs you now, each room now and over time, and how the STARKVIND air purifier is doing. Read from the DIRIGERA hub every 30 s.
